idea-plugin.name: Accenture Java Formatter
idea-plugin.description:
Enterprise-grade Java code formatting plugin for IntelliJ IDEA, implementing Accenture Java code style rules.
Features:
  • Rule 1: Annotations on dedicated lines
  • Rule 4: Method & constructor parameter line wrapping (>1 params and long single param >= 70 cols)
  • Rule 5: extends, implements, throws clause line splitting
  • Rule 6: Method call argument multiline wrapping
  • Rule 7: Assignment RHS 2x continuation indentation
  • Rule 8: Object chaining (>= 2 dots)
  • Rule 9: Line length wrapping (70 columns)
  • Rule 10: Automatic format integration (Ctrl+Alt+L / Cmd+Option+L and format on save)
  • Ternary Operator Engine: Multiline statement lookahead joining & clean 3-line formatting
  • Import Organizer: Sorting and grouping Java imports
  • 100% Idempotent Formatting
